test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A person who believes in non-violence
solution: The correct answer is: **Pacifist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Pacifist"** refers to a person who believes in non-violence and opposes war and conflict. They advocate for peace and harmony instead of aggression or violence. (अहिंसा में विश्वास रखने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** Gandhi was a well-known pacifist who used non-violent methods to fight for India’s independence. • A pacifist promotes peaceful resolutions to disputes and firmly opposes the use of violence as a solution. (शांति का समर्थन करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** The pacifist refused to join the army, citing his belief in non-violence. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pacifist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Extremist** (कट्टरपंथी): A person who holds extreme or radical views, especially in politics or religion. • **Example:** The extremist group staged protests against the government’s reforms. • **Agitator** (उकसाने वाला): A person who stirs up trouble or incites others to take action, often in a disruptive manner. • **Example:** The agitator managed to rally a crowd to protest the new law. • **Rebel** (विद्रोही): A person who resists authority, control, or tradition, often in a defiant or revolutionary way. • **Example:** The rebel soldiers took control of the city after a long battle. 34:T6bd, The correct answer is **option 1.**
